notes: Step 1 parts were correct and are unchanged: Arduino Uno, SCP1000 breakout and 7 hook-up wires, with no breadboard (the circuit image wires the sensor directly to the Arduino).
Pin mapping follows the sketch comments and the schematic: DRDY to D6, CSB to D7 (the schematic crosses these two lines), MOSI to D11, MISO to D12, SCK to D13.
The sensor is powered from the Arduino 3.3V pin (the SCP1000 is a 3.3 V part), and its GND goes to an Arduino GND pin (GND.1 chosen; any GND would do).
The Arduino Uno board is assumed for 'Arduino board', as drawn in the image. Its 5 V logic levels on the SPI lines are as the tutorial shows; no level shifting is drawn, so none was added.
